children: Overview
Singapore AI-powered education provider's Q3 revenue rose 81% yr/yr, driven by business unit growth
Company posted net profit from operations, reversing prior yr loss
Gross margin expanded, reflecting shift to higher-margin education programs
Outlook
Company plans to scale Genius City model globally, targeting 100 Genius Cities
Genius Group to pursue $1.2 bln capital plan, including AI and Bitcoin treasury strategy
Company sees growing demand for AI-powered education and reskilling solutions
Result Drivers
BUSINESS UNIT GROWTH - Co said Q3 revenue growth was driven by Genius School, Genius Academy and Genius Resorts
HIGHER-MARGIN PROGRAMS - Co attributed gross margin expansion to shift toward higher-margin education programs
UNIT PROFITABILITY - All three operating units were profitable in Q3, contributing to overall net profit
